- Integration metadata matches the checked-out ref, so there is no branch blocker.
- Clarification mapping: no `Q1/Q2/...` were issued; `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` means proceed on the issue text as written.
- Codebase check: the issue’s `full` inventory matches the current top-level `workflow-templates/*.yml` set on this ref.

1. Files likely to change
- `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt` (new)
- `workflow-templates/profiles/standard.txt` (new)
- `workflow-templates/profiles/full.txt` (new)

- `README.md`
- `agents.md`
- `tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py`

2. Functions / modules to implement
- `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt`
  - Add a one-wrapper-per-line manifest with exactly:
    - `ai-clarify.yml`
    - `ai-plan.yml`
    - `ai-implement.yml`
    - `ai-review.yml`
    - `ai-issue-pr-status.yml`
    - `ai-cancel-on-pr-close.yml`
- `workflow-templates/profiles/standard.txt`
  - Add core +:
    - `ai-orchestrate.yml`
    - `ai-orchestrate-poll.yml`
    - `ai-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml`
    - `ai-validate.yml`
    - `review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml`
- `workflow-templates/profiles/full.txt`
  - Add every current top-level wrapper on this ref:
    - `ai-cancel-on-pr-close.yml`
    - `ai-clarify.yml`
    - `ai-implement.yml`
    - `ai-issue-pr-status.yml`
    - `ai-memory-maintenance.yml`
    - `ai-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml`
    - `ai-orchestrate-poll.yml`
    - `ai-orchestrate.yml`
    - `ai-plan.yml`
    - `ai-review.yml`
    - `ai-update-workflows.yml`
    - `ai-validate.yml`
    - `review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml`
- `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`
  - Extend the existing `Compare and update workflow wrappers` step instead of adding a new helper script.
  - Read `vars.WORKFLOW_PROFILE` with default `full`.
  - Load `workflow-templates/profiles/<profile>.txt` from the fetched upstream checkout and narrow the wrapper candidate set to the manifest entries.
  - Preserve current fail-fast validation ordering, current copy/update behavior, audit-gate sync, `.claude` sync, top-level `CLAUDE.md` sync, and the non-destructive “leave unlisted local wrappers in place” behavior.
  - Preserve the existing `SELF_TEMPLATE="ai-update-workflows.yml"` skip contract even though `full.txt` includes that filename.
- `README.md`
  - Add append-only install-profile docs under the existing Quickstart/install area, likely beneath `### 2. Create wrapper workflows`.
  - Document `vars.WORKFLOW_PROFILE`, default `full`, exact meaning of `core` / `standard` / `full`, and that downgrading profiles does not delete already-present wrappers.
- `agents.md`
  - Add machine-greppable profile predicates alongside the existing predicate-style facts, including:
    - `PROFILE.default=full`
    - one line per defined profile
- `tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py`
  - Extend the existing contract-style test file rather than adding a new test harness.

3. Data structures affected
- New plain-text manifests under `workflow-templates/profiles/`, one wrapper basename per line.
- Updater workflow shell state: a selected-profile name plus a manifest-derived wrapper list/array.
- No DB/schema/contracts changes.

4. API / interface changes
- New operator surface: `vars.WORKFLOW_PROFILE` with supported values `core`, `standard`, `full`; default `full`.
- No new GitHub API calls.
- No consumer-repo migration logic and no cross-repo edits.

5. Risks / edge cases / conflicts
- Conflict to document clearly: README already uses “core wrappers” for the minimum manual trio, while the new `core` install profile is a six-wrapper manifest. The new docs should disambiguate those terms instead of rewriting unrelated sections.
- Contract nuance: `full.txt` must include `ai-update-workflows.yml`, but the updater must still not overwrite/create its own wrapper.
- Manifest drift risk: `full.txt` can go stale when future top-level wrappers are added; tests should compare it to the live `workflow-templates/*.yml` inventory.
- Invalid/unknown `WORKFLOW_PROFILE` values should fail fast or otherwise surface a clear guardrail signal; silent fallback would make operator choice ambiguous.
- The workflow fetches upstream templates from `coding-workflows@stable`, so real consumer propagation only reflects these changes after the normal release/update path; pre-release verification should stay repo-local.
- Missing-context note: the issue mentions a `files_touched` allowlist, but that serialized allowlist is not present in the planning context. Assumption: it matches the scoped files named above.

6. Testing considerations
- Extend `tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py` to cover:
  - exact `core.txt` membership
  - exact `standard.txt` membership
  - `full.txt` parity with current `workflow-templates/*.yml` inventory and exclusion of non-wrapper assets
  - default-`full` behavior in `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`
  - no-removal-on-downgrade contract
  - preserved self-updater skip
- Reuse the existing CI entrypoint already wired in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  - `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py`
- No CI workflow edit should be required unless the implementation chooses a different test entrypoint.
